seo.title: About
seo.description: Meet Inizh: an Indian studio building IoT systems, custom software, and original games.

intro.headline: We are Inizh
body: Inizh is a small product studio based in Coimbatore, India. We started by making games, fell in love with embedded systems and software along the way, and now build connected products end to end.
Our work spans IoT hardware, cloud dashboards, custom software, and original indie games. We keep teams small, communicate clearly, and ship often.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Build reliable, human-centered technology that solves real problems — and occasionally makes people smile.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: A world where Indian studios are known for both world-class engineering and unforgettable interactive experiences.

values.title: Craft
values.description: We sweat the details so every device, app, and game feels intentional.

values.title: Collaboration
values.description: We work closely with customers and players, not around them.

values.title: Curiosity
values.description: We try bold ideas, share what we learn, and iterate in public.

timeline.title: Studio founded
timeline.description: Inizh started as an indie game studio with a focus on playable experiments.

timeline.title: First prototypes
timeline.description: Space Shooter and Yoi-Yurei prototypes went into active development.

timeline.title: IoT + software expansion
timeline.description: We began shipping connected-device pilots and custom software for small businesses.

timeline.title: New website, same mission
timeline.description: A unified home for our IoT, software, and game work.
